set.typical_award_size: HCD awarded Nevada County a Prohousing Designation on May 27, 2025 (score 60) following Resolution 24-391 (July 9, 2024). On March 24, 2026 (Resolution 26-093) the Board authorized a PIP application of up to $1,250,000 for housing planning and implementation activities (ADU prototype plans, rezoning in unincorporated communities, housing programs). HCD's PIP Round 4 final awardee list shows the County of Nevada requested $1,000,000 and was awarded $469,174.54. PIP Round 5 caps awards at $2 million per jurisdiction (base award by population plus a designation score bonus).
set.cycle_notes: Round 4 awarded (County of Nevada $469,174.54). Round 5 NOFA released October 13, 2026; applications due March 31, 2027; awards expected June 2027.
set.next_deadline: PIP Round 5 applications due March 31, 2027 (Prohousing Designation must be held by March 31, 2027); awards expected June 2027. The County's designation is active and must be maintained with housing element compliance.
set.audit_note: Spot check Nov 9, 2026: staff report SR 26-0126 confirms designation date, score and the $1,250,000 authorization. prevailing_wage_trigger false is uncited.

reason: Material: typical_award_size, application_cycle and next_deadline said no award was posted and the program was closed, but HCD awarded the County $469,174.54 in Round 4 and Round 5 applications are due March 31, 2027.
